text.p: Western Staff Services Inc said Monday that it has restructured its management so that the corporate office and all operating divisions of Western Staff Services will now report directly to President and Chief Operating Officer Michael Phippen.
Western Staff Services issued a news release saying the move is a step in its ongoing strategic realignment since the company made its initial public offering last year.
"This shift will ensure a smoother decision-making process, give us a singular decision point, and an increased focus on performance in individual areas of responsibility," the news release said.

Western Staff Services provides staffing services through a network of more than 380 company-owned, franchised and licensed offices in the United States and five foreign countries with system revenues in fiscal 1996 of $520,000 million.
